 // Reset synchroniser: asynchronous assert, synchronous release.
 // With test_i high the reset passes straight through.
+// Modified by hdl-vet; scripts: override_levels.py sha256:5a4629f7b59c
 module rst_sync #(
   parameter int STAGES = 2
 ) (
   input  logic clk_i,
   input  logic rst_ni,
   input  logic test_i,
-  output logic rst_no
+  output logic rst_no,
+  input  logic bypass_en_i
 );
+  logic rst_no_pre;
   logic [STAGES-1:0] q;

   always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni)
     if (!rst_ni) q <= '0;
     else         q <= {q[STAGES-2:0], 1'b1};

-  assign rst_no = test_i ? rst_ni : q[STAGES-1];
+  assign rst_no_pre = test_i ? rst_ni : q[STAGES-1];
+  assign rst_no = bypass_en_i ? rst_ni : rst_no_pre;
 endmodule
